messages.message: Hi! Welcome to Nimbus Telecom. I'm Vikram. How can I help you today? 😊
Hey, my phone is acting up. The screen is flickering and it just keeps restarting. It's super annoying.
I'm sorry to hear that. Before we dive into the account, could you please provide your account number and full name?
Sure, it's Rohan Patel, account 23134790. Phone number is 92424 35866.
Thanks, Rohan. I totally understand how frustrating it is when your device doesn't work properly. I'll do my best to help.
Yeah, it's a brand new phone and it's already broken. I want a replacement or a refund for the overcharge on my last bill too.
Trust me, the money will definitely be back in your account by tomorrow.
Okay, but what about the phone? I can't use it for work. This is ridiculous.
Let me check the warranty status. One moment please.
I've been waiting for like 5 minutes. This is taking way too long. 🙄
I'm still looking into it. The system is a bit slow today.
I'm done with this. Your service is terrible. I'm going to cancel my plan and switch to another provider immediately.
I will open a ticket for the device issue to be reviewed by the technical team.
